job.title: SAP Commerce Cloud Backend Platform Engineer

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Backend Platform Engineer | Senior Java & Spring Developer
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs, platform upgrades, dependency and data-pipeline management, secure integration, CI/CD deployments and production support. Proven techno-functional consulting, requirements analysis and stakeholder collaboration across international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud Backend Platform Engineer
cover_en.hook: I am excited to join Sqli1 because of its reputation for delivering robust SAP Commerce Cloud solutions at scale. With over five years of hands-on experience driving backend platform development, upgrades and integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I can immediately contribute to owning the platform lifecycle you describe.

bullets.label: Platform Lifecycle & Upgrades
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I led end-to-end backend enhancements on SAP Commerce Cloud 2211 and executed API migrations that modernized the platform and ensured seamless upgrades across global sites.

bullets.label: Dependency & Data Integration Management
bullets.text: Designed and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, handling complex dependency management and ensuring data consistency.

bullets.label: Security & Authorization Support
bullets.text: Implemented secure OCC REST services and collaborated with international teams to address integration bottlenecks, applying platform best practices for authentication and authorization.

bullets.label: Production & CI/CD Operations
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) and provided production support, quickly resolving incidents and maintaining platform stability.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, invitation to talk

tailoring.why_company: Sqli1’s commitment to accelerating digital commerce through innovative SAP Commerce Cloud implementations aligns with my passion for building scalable, secure e-commerce platforms. I admire your portfolio of complex, multi-tenant projects and your focus on continuous platform optimization, which offers the perfect environment for me to apply my SAP Commerce expertise and contribute to your clients’ success.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to help Sqli1 deliver secure, high-performing e-commerce platforms while growing within a forward-thinking digital services leader.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years at Rockwell and Shell. I’m eager to discuss how I can help Sqli1 own and evolve your backend platform. Open to chat?
tailoring.email_subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud Backend Platform Engineer
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Commerce Cloud Backend Platform Engineer role at Sqli1. With over five years of experience delivering backend solutions, platform upgrades and integrations on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can add immediate value. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit.
